platform.isolation: QEMU user networking with restrict=on (no host or internet access); SSH and LuCI forwards to localhost only

start_state: Copy of the development test disk with all LaneKeep dependencies installed and listed in /etc/apk/world; previous LaneKeep files removed before the test

browser.browser: Claude desktop built-in browser against the VM LuCI on localhost
browser.cache: same browser context, cache enabled, no forced reload
browser.note: The pane was hidden, so requestAnimationFrame did not fire and LuCI held its queued RPC calls; the check replaced requestAnimationFrame with a short timer in the page. Status and Details show the read-error bar on a disabled instance because sampling is not running (unchanged code).

not_covered: explicit activation, kill-switch gate and transparent client traffic
real nodes, subscriptions and node test through the panel RPC
known_issue: Uninstall leaves a dangling /etc/rc.d/K9lanekeep link; the v0.1.0 acceptance disk shows the same link, and packaging scripts are unchanged.
